claim_core.statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), count actual induced nine-vertex rook subsets once by vertex sets and let d_T=6-r_T. Suppose R=227, every d_T is0,1 or2, and exactly five triangles have deficiency2. There are fourteen deficiency1 triangles. Let S be their support, k their fourfold-incidence point count, h the number of outside-S points on deficiency2 triangles, w half the deficiency1 point incidence and E_w the actual weighted edge sum. Selected multiplicities are2 or4. Exactly one necessary case occurs: k0/h1 with |S|21,e(S)51 or52 and its outside point S-degree6..8 or6..7 respectively; k0/h2 with |S|21,e(S)46..53 and shared-one-root triple fans; or k1/h2 with |S|20,shared-one-root triple fans,w2 at its unique fourfold point and E_w54,55 or56. In the last case, if the fourfold point is the joining root's only S point, E_w54 or55. No surviving case is asserted realizable and this does not exclude b5 or R227.

scope.description: Universal conditional necessary weighted-support, ordinary edge and outside-neighbor ranges only for R227/maxd2/exactly five D2 triangles. Retains the three k/h cases and literal e/E_w ranges, including k1/h2 weight2 and scalar equality boundaries. No surviving case is asserted realizable; no b5 or R227 exclusion.

assumptions: complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2)
R=227 counts actual induced nine-vertex rook subsets once by their vertex sets
d_T=6-r_T belongs to {0,1,2} for every actual triangle
exactly five actual triangles have deficiency2
limitations: Only the frozen necessary-condition statement is verified, under explicit R227/maxd2/exactly-five hypotheses. No b5/R227/target exclusion or survivor realization.
Unique fourfold point and weight2 retained in k1/h2; support21 indicator formulas do not apply there.
E_w includes every actual edge; l counts selected edges only. No support-inducedness, equitability, automorphism or uniform profile assumption.
Ordinary integral weights and real/rational Q are used; no finite-field rank/nonzero code assumption.
Y=3Qw has norm63q/residue1mod3. The factor-nine rejected outline gives no gate; argument failure is not a REFUTED theorem.
Scalar z0/a2 and z1/a1 equalities are retained without graph feasibility or obstruction claims.
Later stronger survivor challenges are separate; Native discoveries need different-author review.
